name: gaspol-pitch
description: Orchestrates investor/accelerator pitch-deck creation: discovery -> narrative -> draft -> adversarial investor review -> visual -> finish. Reuses installed marketing skills as the engine; the differentiator is a rubric-driven skeptic-investor linter that scores and blocks a weak deck before you send it. Outputs a Marp markdown deck + one nano-banana-pro image prompt per slide (MCP-optional).
